correctness.rationale: Recomputed Q={1,3,4,5,9} and all facets t+Q. The (11,5,2) difference design yields complete face vector (11,55,110,55,11). Enumerated all 55 missing triangles as one orbit of {0,1,3}; its boundary is filled by three present triangles with cone point 2, hence π1=0. Every 4-face/5-face lies in a unique design facet, permitting 55 prescribed free-face collapses to f=(11,55,66), a 2-complex with Euler characteristic 22 and π1=0; Hurewicz plus 2-dimensional homological Whitehead give wedge 21 S². Separately enumerated signed fixed-face Lefschetz values across all 55 affine elements, agreeing with (21,-1,1). Averaging yields (21-10+44)/55=1; only rational homology of geometric quotient is asserted.

originality.rationale: The general directed neighborhood-complex and edge-Hom theorems of Dochtermann–Singh establish the framework and ask about tournament homotopy, but do not determine the Paley-11 complex, 21 spheres, or the affine representation. Jones supplies the tournament affine automorphisms, not the action on these homology groups. The published Paley-19 directed FLAG and Paley-13 undirected graph neighborhood results concern different complexes and parameters.
